churches.name: Albany Baptist Church
churches.pastor: Pastor William Hill, Pastor Drew Grumbles, Pastor Mark Sarver (elders)

score_notes.christology: Statement of Faith affirms Trinity ('one God, eternally existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit') and Christ's deity ('very and eternal God') with substitutionary atonement. Grounded in London Baptist Confession 1689.
score_notes.scripture: Bible-believing evangelical posture; inerrancy typically affirmed.
score_notes.gender: Male-only eldership confirmed.
score_notes.leadership: Male pastor(s) confirmed via church website.
score_notes.soteriology: Historic evangelical gospel of grace through faith alone.
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/social-justice language on site; content remains doctrinal and confessional focused on 'Preaching the Truths of Grace to the Capital Region.'
score_notes.preaching: Doctrinal/confessional emphasis consistent with 1689 Reformed Baptist tradition; specific expository methodology not explicitly stated but confession-rooted preaching implied.
score_notes.mission: Mission language modest — tagline 'Preaching the Truths of Grace to the Capital Region' emphasizes gospel proclamation over programmatic Great Commission language.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: 'Men's Book Study' listed as an ongoing ministry on the church website.
score_notes.denominational: Homepage fetch returned empty content — 1689 Reformed Baptist identity and three-elder plurality (Hill/Grumbles/Sarver) retained per prior research; no contradictory evidence found.

churches.assessment: Albany Baptist Church is led by a plurality of male elders (William Hill, Drew Grumbles, Mark Sarver). Multi-elder governance is a strong biblical pattern. Reformed Baptist churches hold firmly to inerrancy, particular redemption, and male-only eldership. Strong candidate for theological alignment.
churches.enrichment_notes: [2026-06-17] Phase 6f live-fetch verdict: timeout. Site may be defunct or church may use Facebook/social instead of website. NOT a doctrinal flag — research social channel before publishing.

score_notes.christology: ARP affirms Nicene orthodoxy — Christ fully God and fully man, sole mediator.
score_notes.scripture: Westminster Standards affirmed — Scripture inerrant, infallible, sufficient.
score_notes.gender: Male-only teaching and ruling elders per ARP Form of Government. Male-only clergy.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male elders with ARP Synod/presbytery accountability; historic Scots-Irish Presbyterian polity.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformation soteriology — Westminster Confession articulation of sola fide/sola gratia/solus Christus.
score_notes.cultural: Conservative Southern Presbyterian heritage; resistant to progressive theology; historic commitments intact.
score_notes.preaching: Expository preaching from the whole counsel of God; traditional Presbyterian homiletic.
score_notes.mission: Great Commission and covenantal Reformed evangelism; Erskine heritage of missions.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Varies by congregation; historic ARP emphasizes household-led discipleship.
score_notes.denominational: ARP (Associate Reformed Presbyterian) — conservative Southern Presbyterian denomination with Erskine College/Seminary heritage and male-only officers.

churches.assessment: Historic ARP congregation in upstate New York, Northeast Presbytery. Westminster Confession and Catechisms, male-only officers, Erskine-Seceder Presbyterian heritage; one of the oldest northern ARP churches.

score_notes.gender: BPC male-only ordination per Westminster Standards; homepage shows Ladies' Bible Study and Cornerstone Women's Ministry as lay-led support ministries, not pastoral.

score_notes.preaching: Pastor Backus holds Ph.D. — expect scholarly Reformed preaching.
score_notes.mission: Small church in Western NY, part of Great Lakes Presbytery.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Verify dedicated men's programming; small congregation.
score_notes.denominational: Confirmed via biblepres.org homepage: 'A Reformed Bible Presbyterian Church on Grand Island.' BPC — formed 1937 by Carl McIntire, J. Oliver Buswell, and Allan MacRae; fundamentalist-leaning, strongly confessional Reformed.

churches.assessment: The Bible Presbyterian Church on Grand Island, New York is part of the Bible Presbyterian Church's Great Lakes Presbytery. Senior Pastor Dr. Kevin M. Backus holds a Ph.D. — unusually strong academic credentials for a small-denomination pastor. The BPC was formed in 1937 by Carl McIntire, J. Oliver Buswell, and Allan MacRae as a conservative fundamentalist-leaning breakaway Presbyterian denomination holding the Westminster Standards with a pronounced emphasis on biblical inerrancy and separation from liberalism. The denomination is very small (only 28 churches across the US and one in Canada) — MOOP readers considering BPC congregations should understand they will likely find a small, tight-knit, strongly-convictional Reformed fellowship rather than a large-church experience. Green-rated orthodox Reformed option for the Buffalo, NY metro.

churches.assessment: Cornerstone Baptist Church at 574 Madison Street in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, is the lifelong home church of House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-NY-8). Jeffries grew up in Crown Heights and was formed at Cornerstone — in his youth becoming one of the church's white-gloved, dues-paying ushers, tending to crying babies and handling neighborhood traffic during worship. Cornerstone is institutionally part of the National Baptist Convention USA, the largest historically Black Baptist denomination. Rev. Lawrence E. Aker III is current senior pastor. NBC-USA is generally evangelical-Baptist on core doctrine but specific posture on sexuality, women in pastoral ministry, and biblical inerrancy varies by congregation. Per MOOP rubric this is YELLOW — would need on-site verification of confessional posture and pulpit theology before a recommendation; included with notable-attendees context for the most prominent Democratic House leader.

churches.assessment: Marble Collegiate Church is one of America's most historically significant Reformed congregations, with roots back to 1628 and the current Marble building dedicated in 1854. Norman Vincent Peale served as pastor from 1932 to 1984, building a half-century legacy of positive-thinking preaching that profoundly shaped a young Donald Trump — whose family attended faithfully during his childhood and whose first wedding Peale officiated. Today Marble is led by Rev. Dr. Michael Bos and is openly LGBT-affirming, rejects biblical inerrancy in favor of historical-critical hermeneutics, performs same-sex weddings, and participates annually in NYC Pride. Dual-affiliated with the RCA and the UCC — both progressive mainlines, with the UCC being the most theologically progressive mainline in America. This is RED on the MOOP rubric; included for situational awareness about the formative church of a sitting president.

churches.gender_detail: Egalitarian leadership; female pastors and elders; same-sex marriages performed.

churches.assessment: St. James' Episcopal Church in Hyde Park was Franklin D. Roosevelt's lifelong parish — he served on the vestry and as senior warden, even continuing in that role during his presidency. He, Eleanor, and the Roosevelt family worshiped here whenever they were at the Hyde Park estate (now the Home of FDR National Historic Site, 2.7 miles south of the church). Founded 1811 by residents including Samuel Bard (George Washington's physician), it remains an active parish of the Episcopal Diocese of New York under recently installed Rector The Rev. Meredith Kadet Sanderson (October 2025). The church is theologically within TEC's mainline trajectory — orthodox in creedal Christology, but progressive on sexuality and ordination per General Convention decisions. Beautiful Hudson Valley historic site; significant theological distance from MOOP's confessional commitments.
